narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} came apart that same month, and the ghost's salary never again arrived without something already waiting for it. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's days were a shade fuller, Life ending {life_gap}.
